_readme: One entry per location a player can visit in the Prologue and Act 1. safe_name is a spoiler-free label shown in the app; first_act is the earliest milestone at which the location is reachable. Bulk items (pictos, weapons, outfits, flags, journals) inherit their spoiler severity from first_act. Fill this in during week 1 (docs/WEEK1.md, day 2).

sources.name: guide name
sources.claim: what it says about this location
